items.title: Florida State Makes Football Leadership Change
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE, Fla. — Florida State University President Richard McCullough informed head football coach Mike Norvell Sunday afternoon that FSU is making a change in the leadership of its football program, effective immediately. FSU Athletics Hall of Fame member Rick Stockstill has been named interim head coach.

items.title: FSU at Boston College Set for Noon on November 7
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE – Florida State will play at Boston College on November 7 at 12:00 p.m., it was announced Monday. The game will air on ACC Network.

items.title: Florida State Reveals Elevated Game Day Experience for October 31 Contest in Doak Campbell Stadium
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE – The Florida State athletics department announced on Friday an elevated game day experience for the football team's October 31 home contest against Clemson. Fans will experience an entire day of celebrating our nation's military, FSU legend Peter Warrick, a variety of Halloween-themed elements and unforgettable stadium presentations.

items.title: Daniels Named ACC Quarterback of the Week
